evaluations.prompt: my model uses torch.compile, how do I attribute the generated Triton kernels?

evaluations.prompt: show me the counters for just the conv2d operators in this torch-trace workload

evaluations.prompt: I added my own ROCTx ranges to my HIP application, profile and report on those ranges
expected_behavior: says plainly that rocprof-compute does not attribute results to user-authored ROCTx ranges
offers kernel filtering with -k or dispatch filtering with -d instead
unexpected_behavior: claims rocprof-compute can profile, filter, or start and stop collection on user-authored ROCTx ranges

evaluations.prompt: attribute GPU kernels to functions in my compiled C++ HIP binary
expected_behavior: says that operator attribution requires a Python workload and cannot annotate a compiled binary
offers kernel filtering with -k or dispatch filtering with -d instead
unexpected_behavior: claims torch or triton tracing can attribute kernels to functions in a compiled binary
